questions.question: Identify the sentence with correct inversion after the adverbial phrase 'Only when he arrived' (meaning the action happened only after arrival).
options: Only when he arrived did he realize the mistake.
Only when he arrived did he realized the mistake.
Only when he arrived he realized the mistake.
Only when he arrived he realized the mistake.
questions.answer: Only when he arrived did he realize the mistake.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize 'the fact that she was late'?
options: It was her being late that caused the delay.
It was her being late that caused the delay.
It was her being late that caused the delay.
It was her being late that caused the delay.
questions.answer: It was her being late that caused the delay.

questions.question: Select the correct form of the subjunctive in the following sentence: 'I suggest that she _____ to the meeting immediately.'
options: goes
went
go
had gone

questions.question: Which option correctly completes the sentence with ellipsis, maintaining grammatical coherence? 'He knows more about the subject than _____.'
options: she does.
she did.
she has.
she will.

questions.question: Identify the sentence that correctly uses a complex sentence structure with a non-restrictive relative clause in formal register: 'The report, which was completed last week, contains several recommendations.'
options: The report, which was completed last week, contains several recommendations.
The report, which was completed last week, contains several recommendations.
The report, which was completed last week, contains several recommendations.
The report, which was completed last week, contains several recommendations.
questions.answer: The report, which was completed last week, contains several recommendations.
